question: V Československu bola medzi modelármi veľmi obľúbená mierka TT. Je menšia ako bežná H0, takže sa celá trať zmestila aj do malého bytu v paneláku. Z ktorých dvoch anglických slov pochádza skratka TT?
source_excerpt: TT comes from 'table top,' because the scale was meant to make a train set small enough to run on a tabletop.

extra.why_interesting: Many Slovaks grew up with TT trains or had them at home, but few know what the abbreviation means. The answer explains why the scale existed at all: so a whole railway could fit on a table in a small flat. A player can reason it out from the hint about size.
extra.verification_notes: Wikipedia confirms TT stands for 'table top', that it is 1:120 and so smaller than H0 (1:87), and that it is popular in Central Europe.

explanation: Table Top znamená doska stola, teda železnica, ktorá sa zmestí na stôl. Vláčiky v mierke 1:120 vyrábali najmä v NDR a predávali sa po celom východnom bloku.

question: Ktorý svetoznámy britský rocker s chrapľavým hlasom si roky staval obrovskú modelovú železnicu s veľkomestom a mrakodrapmi a na turné si v hoteloch objednával izbu navyše, aby na nej mohol pracovať?
source_excerpt: Sir Rod would take kits, tools and paints with him and book an extra hotel room for a workshop; hotels were told in advance and took out the beds and provided fans

extra.why_interesting: Players picture model railway fans as quiet retired men in a basement. The answer is a world-famous rock star with a rock-and-roll lifestyle who quietly built skyscrapers out of cardboard. The raspy voice and the touring are footholds that let players reason their way to him.
extra.verification_notes: Rod Stewart's 1,500 sq ft model railway city is well documented, as is his habit of booking an extra hotel room on tour to work on it (collectors-club-of-great-britain.co.uk).

explanation: Rod Stewart staval svoje mesto inšpirované Amerikou zo štyridsiatych rokov vyše dvadsať rokov. Mrakodrapy vyrábal vlastnoručne, a keď ho v roku 2019 ukázal v modelárskom časopise, modelári boli úplne ohromení.
